messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up: target tonight for v2 default flip is 22:30 UTC. Low-traffic window, aim for staged flip with 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m if signals are green. Post pin requests now if you need tenants held back.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: id=deploy-176753, window=2025-02-13T22:30:00Z->2025-02-13T23:30:00Z, canary=10%, operator-rollforward, fallback=v1 warm for 20m. Confirm to start.

nina: Confirming SDK teams have been notified. Are we enabling the proxy casefolding rule for header names? Some older SDKs depend on exact header-case.

morgan: We'll enable proxy casefolding for v2; no response payload changes. SDK note posted to the docs PR.

felix: Rollback thresholds I propose: overall 5xx > 1.0% sustained for 3m OR p95 regression > +150ms for 5m. Also watch tenant-specific error bumps >1% for mobile-heavy tenants.

tara: +1. Add auth fail spike (401) >0.5% sustained 5m as a soft abort to check SDK token refresh behavior.

lee: Ops runbook link is in the deploy. If rolling back operators should run:
```
# operator rollback and pin
deploybot rollback deploy-176753 --reason "telemetry"
deploybot pin-route --route "/api" --version v1 --tenant=tenant-id --duration 3h
```

morgan: I'll set up a short shadow pass (same volume as canary) for 5m to validate backend parity before ramp. Also keeping v1 warm + cold-start suppression for 20m.

nina: Docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/908  - needs final approval from SDK lead.

deploybot: canary kickoff queued at 2025-02-13T22:30:00Z. I will post health pings here. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/v2-flip.

felix: Operator monitoring checklist:
- p95/latency, 5xx, auth 401, tenant deltas
- HTTP header presence and X-Api-Version counts
- region eu-west-1 watch: last time we saw a transient routing error there
- if rollback: notify #incidents and run the rollback command

tara: A couple of enterprise tenants requested holdouts; deploybot please pin tenant-2001 and tenant-638.

deploybot: pinned tenants (tenant-2001, tenant-638). Canary started. Pinging metrics...

deploybot: metric snapshot (t+2m): overall 5xx=0.09%, p95 latency +12ms, mobile errors 0.25%, auth failures 0.02%.

lee: Good. Ramp to 50% at operator discretion. Keep eyes on eu-west-1.

morgan: Ramp to 50% now. Shadow pass looks clean.

deploybot: ramped to 50%. streaming updates.

deploybot: metric snapshot (t+11m): overall 5xx=0.22%, p95 +45ms, mobile errors 0.6%, auth 0.04%. Mobile errors slightly up but below tenant threshold.

nina: Noting release notes final wording: "/api default routing moves to v2; proxy will normalize header casing; tenants can pin to v1 if needed." PR merged.

felix: If mobile errors trend up >1% escalate to infra. For now continue 20m warm period then final cut if steady.

deploybot: final flip: default route switched to v2 at 2025-02-13T22:52:00Z. v1 kept warm for 20m. Will post retire notice once warm window completes.

tara: Monitoring 20m window. If anything crosses rollback gates we execute rollback command and pin affected tenants.

lee: Thread will be on ops watch. Great work everyone. :shipit:
